items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1966-03-09
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] That was Dave Oxley... [INTERVIEWEE] The one who came in there, he's a drummer.

ctx.x: Well there's a lot of drummers around here I like to work. What I like to do is George Williams was born. You know George Williams? He died just last year. Yeah he died, that's right. And you take this boy, Lionel, the boy was up there that night there. What's his name? That night we played up there. At the hall there?
That was Dave Oxley. Not Dave, I'm talking about the boy coming there.
The one who came in there, he's a drummer.
